name: systemd (services, sessions, power, logs)

1.how: systemctl [--user] status|start|stop|restart|enable|list-units --failed; journalctl [--user] -u <unit> -n 100 --since '1 hour ago' -o json; loginctl lock-session; systemctl suspend|reboot|poweroff
1.notes: User units (mausd, ollama for the user…) need no root; system units do.

1.how: org.freedesktop.systemd1 (Manager: ListUnits, StartUnit…), org.freedesktop.login1 (Suspend, LockSession, PrepareForSleep signal), org.freedesktop.UPower (battery)
1.notes: Observation sources: sleep/wake, battery, failed units.

2.how: ~/.config/systemd/user/*.service for user units; /etc/systemd/system for system units (root)

quirks: Omarchy's crash notifications come from systemd-coredump; `coredumpctl list` and `coredumpctl info <pid>` read them.
